headline: ADVENTURE joins the harness spine — and we finally see how hard it really is
lede: The forge's most recent game was invisible to every shared bot: no contract roster entry, no position in its state. #1568 wired it in (spine 44→45 games), and a 200-seed first-timer probe measured the result: 0% wins, median 6 of 18 rooms, and 0 seeds of 200 ever opened a castle gate.

notes.text: adventure is now on the contractGames roster with a driving script and live x/y state — contractcheck, juiceaudit, nightly-bot and the boredom map all see it from tonight's runs.

First-timer data (200 novice seeds): 57.5% never pick up any item; 56 seeds find the gold key yet zero discover the drop-the-key gate rite. Three honest gaps (variant selector, gate affordance, guidance page) landed in the README.
Fidelity pass first, then provability: every claim in the pass was measured in Node before it entered the README; the harness proves it can fail (18/18 mutants die).
Next up (filed #1572): gate-threshold affordance, a controls+castles hints tab, and a three-variant SELECT GAME.
